Text: The Journey of Faith
Heading: A Spiral, Not a Ladder
Text: Spiritual growth is rarely linear. We receive, question, seek, rebuild, …
blocks.value: Spiritual growth is rarely linear. We receive, question, seek, rebuild, embody, and awaken - often more than once. No stage is a rank, and no stage makes anyone more loved by God.

blocks.label: Text: The stages describe how our relationship to faith may change - not God's…
blocks.value: The stages describe how our relationship to faith may change - not God's relationship to us. Jesus remains at the center of the journey.

blocks.value: You may be less interested in collecting spiritual ideas and more interested in becoming a person whose life carries the character of Jesus.

blocks.label: Text: One common risk is turning formation into performance - adding more prac…
blocks.value: One common risk is turning formation into performance - adding more practices, trying harder, or measuring yourself against an ideal. The invitation is gentler: choose rhythms that help you abide in love, receive grace, and become increasingly available to others.

blocks.value: God is present in meals, traffic, work, conflict, rest, and the quiet choices no one applauds.

blocks.value: Sleep, breathing, eating, movement, limits, and attention shape how you love.

blocks.label: Heading: Practice is cooperation, not earning.

blocks.value: Practices make space to receive and embody the love already given.

blocks.label: Heading: Love is the measure.

blocks.value: Look for freedom, compassion, courage, humility, and care for others.
